mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_take_order (order_no, warehouse_id, status, snapshot_time, remark, operator_id) VALUES (#{order.orderNo}, #{order.warehouseId}, #{order.status}, #{order.snapshotTime}, #{order.remark}, #{order.operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT order_no FROM stock_take_order WHERE order_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') ORDER BY order_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_take_order SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.name AS warehouseName, o.status, o.snapshot_time AS snapshotTime, o.remark, o.operator_id AS operatorId, u.real_name AS operatorName, o.create_time AS createTime FROM stock_take_order o LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON o.warehouse_id = w.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.operator_id = u.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
